It is given by intravenous infusion H N P OH HO O P OH OH O 1100 Bone Modulating Drugs as incadronate disodium for hypercalcaemia of malignancy in a dose of 10 mg over 2 to 4 hours; if necessary this dose may be repeated at intervals of no less than 1 week.
